full_prompt_en: A square graphic anime illustration shows a black-haired schoolboy before a storm of magenta lightning and a ghostlike duplicate of his face. The background is a dense violet-purple field crossed by many irregular branching lines in pink, lavender, and pale cyan. At the front left, the boy is seen from the waist upward in a black stand-collar school uniform with a narrow light trim and a row of pale buttons. His arms fold across his chest, making a firm triangular base below the round, expressionless face. Short dark hair spikes unevenly around the head, while wide pale eyes with tiny pupils stare ahead under straight brows. Behind and to his right, a larger translucent copy of the same head and upper body emerges from the magenta field, its features simplified and tinted hot pink. The double recedes into the storm rather than standing on a separate ground plane. Cyan light rims the boy's left shoulder, ear, and hair, while vivid pink spills across the right side of the face and jacket. The black uniform absorbs much of the light, but the collar edges and buttons stay crisp. Lightning lines loop around both figures, some thin and hairlike, others broader and jagged, creating depth through overlap and glow. The drawing uses spare facial shapes and clean black silhouettes against a highly energized, textured background. Light seems to come from the colored electric lines on both sides, with no ordinary sun or lamp; the resulting shadows are colored violet and blue. The overall composition is direct and charged, keeping a still, deadpan figure at the center of a turbulent neon field.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形图形性动漫插画呈现一名黑发学生，身后是品红闪电风暴和幽影般的面容重影。背景是一片浓重紫罗兰紫色域，被粉、薰衣草紫和浅青色的不规则分叉线穿过。左侧前景，男孩从腰部以上入画，穿黑色立领学生制服，领口有窄浅色饰线，衣前是一排浅色纽扣。他双臂交叉在胸前，在圆润、缺少表情的面孔下形成坚实三角形底座。短深发在头部四周不齐地翘起，瞳孔很小的宽大浅眼睛在平直眉下望向前方。其后偏右，一张更大、半透明的相同头脸和上身从品红色场域中浮出，五官更简化并染成热粉色。重影退入风暴，而不是站在另一片地面上。青色光勾亮男孩左肩、耳朵与头发，鲜艳粉光则洒在脸和外套的右侧。黑制服吸收大部分光，但领口边缘和纽扣保持清脆。闪电线绕过两个形体，有些细如发丝，有些更宽、更锯齿状，靠交叠与发光形成纵深。绘制以简练面部形状和干净黑剪影对照高度活跃、带肌理的背景。光似乎从两边的彩色电线发出，没有普通太阳或灯；阴影因而染成紫与蓝色。整体构图直接而带电，以静止、面无波澜的人影占据躁动霓虹场的中心。
style_prompt_en: The graphic anime style sets economical dark silhouettes and flat expressive features against a saturated, visibly textured neon field. Electric magenta and violet dominate, while thin cyan and lavender branches provide cool counterpoints. A faint offset duplicate or translucent echo gives layered depth without conventional perspective. Lighting comes from the colored field itself, creating split pink and blue rim light on otherwise near-black forms. Clean contours and simple repeated pale accents keep the focal shape legible amid the busy branching background. Fine jagged lines vary in width and brightness, making the still center feel surrounded by motion. The composition is close and cropped, with high contrast concentrated on the face and upper body and diffuse glow spreading to the margins. The overall effect is strange, energetic, and immediate, combining minimal character drawing with volatile color and light.
style_prompt_zh: 这种图形性动漫风格把简练深色剪影和平坦富表情的特征放在饱和、明显带肌理的霓虹色场前。电光般的品红和紫罗兰占主导，细青色与薰衣草色分叉线提供冷色对点。淡薄错位重影或半透明回声无需传统透视便提供叠层纵深。光源来自彩色场域本身，在近黑形体边缘形成粉蓝分色轮廓光。干净轮廓与简洁重复的浅色重音让焦点形状在繁忙分叉背景中仍可读。细锯齿线的宽度和亮度不断变化，使静止中心仿佛被运动包围。构图贴近并裁切，高对比集中在核心形体，散开的辉光延伸至边缘。整体效果奇异、充满能量而直接，把极简的具象绘制与易变色彩、光线结合起来。
theme_en: A black-haired schoolboy before magenta lightning and a ghostlike duplicate
theme_zh: 黑发学生站在品红闪电和幽影般的重影前
name: Mob Psycho 100
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
